metadata.description: Figure 1 Maximum likelihood (ML) phylogenetic tree obtained from an IQ-TREE analysis of representative species in 93 families of Pleosporales based on LSU, ITS, SSU, tef-α, and rpb2 sequence data. Strains under study are shown in blue bold text and their respective families are in orange blocks. Families are indicated on the right side of the tree. Branch support values from 1000 non-parametric bootstraps for IQ-TREE (ML-BS) are shown at the nodes (ML-BS≥80%). The tree is rooted with members of Tubeufiales.

metadata.description: Figure 2 Maximum Likelihood (ML) phylogenetic tree obtained from an IQ-TREE analysis of species from Torulaceae based on LSU, ITS, SSU, tef1α, and rpb2 sequence data. Strain of the species under study is shown in blue bold text, and the type strains are in bold black. Family is indicated on the right side of the tree in blocks. Branch support values from 1000 non-parametric bootstraps for IQ-TREE (ML-BS) and posterior probability values from the Bayesian analysis (BY-PP) are shown at the nodes (ML-BS≥70%/BY-PP≥0.9). The tree is rooted with Occultibambusa bambusae MFLUCC 13-0855 and Neooccultibambusa thailandensis MFLUCC 16-0274.
